title_en: The Vision of the Imam al-Mahdi (may God hasten his noble advent) During the Era of the Greater Occultation
description_en: From the meeting of His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure), with a female delegation from the seminaries (hawza) in Hijaz.
summary: Religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari addresses questions regarding the possibility and nature of encountering the Hidden Imam during the period of the Greater Occultation.
